results.contract: Entering Edit during playback stops the old source and resumes the selected dry loop or current rendered processed loop; obsolete async renders and idle entry must not start playback.
source_evidence: src/webview/services/editListenService.ts:134-149 captures prior playback intent, pauses the old source before changing the cue/selection, then updates listen state with that intent.

src/webview/services/editListenService.ts:259-307 installs active processed state with a null buffer immediately, waits for rendering, checks active/disposal/generation/mode/settings, installs the result, and resumes only a valid result for a previously playing entry.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:767-772 prevents play while processed mode has no processed buffer.
src/webview/services/editListenService.ts:346-350 pauses before leave on disposal, preventing leave from restarting a source during teardown.
test_evidence: src/webview/services/editListenService.test.ts:157-200 asserts the original source is stopped, replacement source identity and buffer, dry selection loop boundaries, and no source can start before processed render completion.
src/webview/services/editListenService.test.ts:202-248 covers leave/dispose/mode/region changes invalidating pending entry and idle entry remaining stopped.
Prior tests for region/mode changes pausing without auto-resume remain unchanged and pass.
rejected_suspicions: An older processed render cannot resume after a new region or mode because the generation and settings guards execute before setEditListenState and play.
The synchronous dry entry intentionally resumes immediately after the old source is paused; it uses the new selection boundaries rather than continuing the stale source.
results.validation_limit: Source lifecycle, buffer identity and loop parameters verified with AudioContext mocks; no acoustic glitch or real-time render latency guarantee is inferred.

results.contract: Toggling Live display or level meters during playback must not recreate the source or reset playback to the fixed cue.
source_evidence: src/webview/services/playerService.ts:217-235 sends display/hearing-protection toggles to downstream routing refresh instead of pause/play.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:455-462 reconnects only gain output during playback; it does not write cue, current playback seconds or start clock.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:740-755 disconnects gain output before reconnecting the correct downstream endpoint and increments the routing generation.
test_evidence: src/webview/services/playerService.test.ts:218-243 toggles both display controls repeatedly while playback has advanced from cue 2 to time 5; asserts one source, no stop, one output/destination path, unchanged cue and advancing playhead.
rejected_suspicions: Removing the explicit _gainConnectGeneration increment from the old band callback is safe: _connectGainOutput and _connectGainToLiveGraph already advance it.
The reconnect path disconnects the gain node first; enabling analysis does not retain the old direct destination connection.
results.validation_limit: Continuity of source and clock and connection cardinality checked; finite tests do not certify sample-level absence of an audible reconnect transient.

results.contract: Non-L/R monitoring and non-bypass band solo must remain effective with Live analysis, meters and hearing protection disabled.
source_evidence: src/webview/services/playerService.ts:373-380 treats non-lr monitoring mode and a non-bypass band mask as independent reasons to retain the live routing graph.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:249-260 routes monitor mode, band-edge and solo-mask changes through the same topology refresh.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:396-407 applies the selected mode matrix; 703-716 builds a selected-band chain before the existing live output path.
src/webview/services/playerService.ts:455-462 updates topology while idle without creating a source.
test_evidence: src/webview/services/playerService.test.ts:245-267 explicitly disables analysis consumers, changes side/LR/solo states, and asserts live graph/direct-output transitions and a single preserved source.
src/webview/services/playerService.test.ts:269-283 asserts mode/solo changes while idle retain required graph state without starting any source.
rejected_suspicions: Returning to LR does not bypass active solo bands: monitorBandBypassActive is independently tested in _needsLiveGraph.
Empty and all-selected masks both correctly restore bypass and tear down the graph when no other consumer needs it.
results.validation_limit: The patch changes graph activation, not the existing monitoring matrix or filter formulas. Focused tests confirm topology and lifecycle, not frequency-response accuracy.

test_integrity.notes: Both service test diffs only append regression cases; no pre-existing test body or assertion was changed.
